## About

Anubhav Gain (mranv) is a security software engineer in Mumbai, India. Since July 2024 he has worked at Infopercept, building the Invinsense XDR deployment architecture and Invinsense Unified Endpoint Control, and has consulted on endpoint security at Mahindra Finance and application security at SBI Life.

Before that he was a DevSecOps engineer at Atcults (November 2023 to July 2024) and an IT security specialist at Parul University (November 2022 to October 2023). He holds a B.Tech in Cyber/Computer Forensics and Counterterrorism from Parul University (2021–2025) and two 2023 licentiates from Charles Sturt University, in Ransomware Techniques and Cybersecurity Management.

He maintains open-source security tools in Rust, Go and Python, including Leviathan, Atomic Prevention, Agni, Krustron and eBPF File Monitor, writes field notes on application control and detection engineering, and founded Gain Fisheries, a fish hatchery in Pakhanjur, Chhattisgarh, in 2020.

## Work

- Security Software Engineer, Infopercept (07/2024 – present): Deployment architecture for Invinsense XDR / OXDR, single and multi-tenant. Custom OpenSearch Dashboards plugins, Rust monitoring agents, Wazuh and Fluent Bit alert pipelines.
- Endpoint Security Consultant, Mahindra Finance (05/2026 – present): Invinsense 7.0 Unified Endpoint Control: application allow-listing, policy review to deployment workflows and endpoint telemetry across Windows, macOS and Linux.
- Application Security Consultant, SBI Life (03/2026 – 05/2026): Application security assessments and VAPT, with design reviews against financial-sector and data-protection standards.
- DevSecOps Engineer, Atcults (11/2023 – 07/2024): Security testing pipelines, infrastructure as code with Terraform, container and Kubernetes hardening.
- IT Security Specialist, Parul University (11/2022 – 10/2023): Palo Alto firewalls, Red Hat and Windows servers, AWS and endpoint configuration management.
- Founder, Gain Fisheries (2020 – present): A fish hatchery in Pakhanjur, Chhattisgarh.

## Open source

- [Leviathan](https://github.com/anubhavg-icpl/leviathan): A Windows kernel-mode EDR/XDR framework written in Rust on windows-drivers-rs.
- [Atomic Prevention](https://github.com/anubhavg-icpl/atomic-prevention): A prevention-focused living-off-the-land testing framework mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.
- [Agni](https://github.com/anubhavg-icpl/agni): A CLI and web UI for running Firecracker microVMs, an alternative to firectl.
- [Krustron](https://github.com/anubhavg-icpl/krustron): An open-source Devtron alternative: one dashboard for clusters, GitOps CI/CD and observability.
- [eBPF File Monitor](https://github.com/mranv/ebpf-file-monitor): File monitoring for Linux in Rust, with inotify and eBPF and timestamped audit logs.
- [Convoy](https://github.com/anubhavg-icpl/convoy): Your own autonomous system on one VPS, as a Docker Compose stack.
